subject: how to adjust legend text when legend position is bottom

messages.author: 1d2e006d333c0101
messages.subject: how to adjust legend text when legend position is bottom
parts:
Hi All,
 
Is it possible to align the legend text horizontally (from left to right) instead of default vertical stack. THis is useful when legend.position is 'bottom' and there are several entries.
 
Many thanks for the support and help.
 
Regards,
 
Krishna
